svg.text: Hold the board with the socket strips facing you and the USB-C port on your right. You are looking at the side with the microSD slot and the dog logo.
P1.1 is 5 V. Nothing ever goes in here.
P1 has 36 sockets in 18 columns. Column 1 is at the USB-C end. Pins 1, 3, 5 ... are the outer row; 2, 4, 6 ... the inner row.
P1 close up, columns 1 to 18 from the USB-C end. Every socket numbered.
P1.14 VDD_3V3, 3.3 V out. Column 7, inner row
P1.26 I2C2_SDA, data. Column 13, inner row
P1.28 I2C2_SCL, clock. Column 14, inner row
